summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the fresh attempt has no attributable exact orbit-interface source or pinned offline Lean/Mathlib project, so compilation, two clean replays, and three axiom reports cannot begin.

value_assessment.novelty: This run independently reproduces the one directly linked contribution's missing-delivery obstruction. It adds executed application-resolution evidence and independent root, stream, and embedded-payload checks that the linked contribution did not complete; it contradicts no mathematical, compiler, or axiom result.

The final proposal and JSONL records passed parsing and contract-shape checks.
value_assessment.falsifier: The finding is overturned by locating attributable pre-review bytes in this attempt that unambiguously contain the exact three declarations and pinned offline Lean/Mathlib project, including an embedded payload missed by the stated checks.

claims.statement: Within the fresh attempt at initial inventory, no delivered ordinary file besides the research brief existed, and the brief did not expose an exact orbit-interface payload under the stated boundary, stream, and bounded content checks; consequently the exact-source replay prerequisite was absent.
claims.evidence_summary: The hidden-inclusive top-level and recursive inventories agreed on one ordinary file and no directories or links; its size and digest were recorded. Independent .NET enumeration, root attributes, alternate-stream inspection, and content indicators found no additional or embedded payload.
claims.verification_method: Repeat hidden-inclusive and direct .NET inventories from the attempt root before adding reviewer files, inspect root link metadata and all streams of the supplied brief, compute its SHA-256 digest, and repeat the specified embedded-payload indicator checks.

limitations: This is a pre-build delivery finding, not a rejected Lean declaration or mathematical result.
No exact declaration type, Lean pin, Mathlib revision, compilation, clean replay, or axiom report was available.
The absence claim is limited to the permitted attempt and the stated filesystem, stream, and content checks.
The result does not bear on the truth of the Riemann Hypothesis or locate an off-critical-line zero.
failed_approaches: The requested compile-and-audit protocol cannot start because no supplier-authored declaration source or pinned project appears in the initial inventory.
A search for an embedded source or archive in the supplied brief found no code fence, digest, Lean project marker, declaration marker, or common encoded-archive prefix.
next_actions: Supply the exact three-declaration source and a pinned, fully materialized offline Lean/Mathlib project in a fresh attempt, then inventory and hash it before executing two clean builds and printing all three axiom reports.
